## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D 60-second kart time trial on one track.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest one.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained Three.js kart racer, “Sunset Circuit,” with three laps, a 60-second timer, keyboard and touch controls, drift boosts, coins, audio toggle, and saved best lap.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive game UI, HUD, overlays, and controls in `index.html` and `styles.css`.
- Implemented the 3D track, kart, scenery, race state, controls, timer, audio, and results in `game.js`.
- Ran syntax and browser checks; verified rendering, countdown, driving, HUD updates, and mobile touch controls.
- Saved and inspected the latest desktop screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/sunset.jpg` (1280×720).

### Active
- Further validate lap completion, timeout/results, restart, and audio toggle behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test lap completion, timer expiration/results, and restart.
2. Investigate two browser console resource 404 messages; no failed project-origin responses were reported.
3. Summarize the game and validation, noting assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface, HUD, overlays, and controls.
- `styles.css`: Visual design and responsive styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Basic desktop and mobile checks passed; desktop showed a running timer and speed HUD, and mobile controls appeared and accelerated the kart.
